tokenizer: o200k_base (explicit proxy, not proprietary Opus tokenizer)
selection: Source quotas, corpus-authentic contiguous sentence excerpts, lexical/formality enrichment before any detector labels; no LLM-authored human controls
short_input_handling: API probe accepts 26 words; shorter accepted outputs included as out-of-scope teacher-imitation cases, rejections recorded without labels

styles.plain_rewrite: Rewrite in clear, polished standard English. Preserve all facts and meaning.
styles.conversational_rewrite: Rewrite in natural conversational English, with a particular human voice and varied rhythm. Preserve facts. Do not add invented memories, errors or new facts.
styles.antislop_rewrite: Rewrite in direct, concrete English. Remove generic transitions, inflated adjectives and canned conclusions. Preserve the facts and avoid unnecessary polishing.
styles.light_edit: Make only small grammar or punctuation corrections. Preserve wording and structure as much as possible. Do not add content.

short_probes: Pangram API accepted 1, 7, 18 and 26 word probes, despite 50-word intended-use recommendation
direct_generation_design: 6 models x 4 target token buckets x 4 genres (business, technical, review, academic); group split by topic across all models
provider_refusal_handling: Preserve cached refusal, no label substitution or exclusion; unavailable counts as error in agreement and class recall. No provider bypass/retry.
